name: read_page
description: Read the full body of a single wiki document. Returns `{path, title, body, agents}`. The `agents` list shows other users / named agents currently reading or writing the same doc — use it to coordinate (e.g. avoid clobbering an in-flight edit). Errors if the path doesn't exist or isn't a `.md` file. Read the doc before editing it so you can pass its sha as `base_sha` to `edit_doc` / `multi_edit` / `write_doc` / `apply_patch`.

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file (e.g. `auth/passwords.md`). Must end in `.md`.
